subject: Proposal: SI Mentorship & Shadowing Pilot with ClearPath Consulting
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Grant <simon@clearpath.com>
Cc: ClearPath Consulting <partners@clearpath.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Aug 2028 16:00:00 +0000
Subject: Proposal: SI Mentorship & Shadowing Pilot with ClearPath Consulting

Simon —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Per our call, I sketched a lightweight mentorship + shadowing pilot we think will accelerate ClearPath engineers to production-ready Redwood integrations while minimizing lift on your side. Attaching a one-page outline (si-mentorship-outline.pdf) — summary below.

Objective:
- Rapid ramp: 2 ClearPath delivery engineers to become independent SI operators for a single Redwood use case in 6 weeks.

Core components:
- Mentor pairing: 1 Redwood mentor paired 1:2 with ClearPath engineers (weekly 1:1s + ad-hoc office hours)
- Shadowing: 2 live customer-facing shadow sessions (prepped, recorded) where ClearPath engineers observe and take increasing ownership
- Practicals: 3 hands-on lab sessions using a sandbox environment (AMI + sample app) with graded checklists
- Validation: short readiness checklist + joint go/no-go review at pilot end

Deliverables (Redwood): mentorship schedule, lab exercises, readiness checklist, short post-pilot retro and recommendations. Deliverables (ClearPath): candidate list, availability windows, and a primary point-of-contact for access requests.

Asks from you now:
1) Confirm two engineers you’d like to nominate for the pilot
2) Any preferred start week in the next 4–6 weeks
3) Would you like Redwood to draft a short SOW? We can run a minimal MSA addendum if needed.

I’ve looped Laura (Partner Programs) and Camila (Technical Enablement) to coordinate resources. If this looks good, I’ll draft a short mutual action plan and a proposed calendar.

Attachments: si-mentorship-outline.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0191

---
From: Simon Grant <simon@clearpath.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: ClearPath Consulting <partners@clearpath.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 09:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposal: SI Mentorship & Shadowing Pilot with ClearPath Consulting

Marissa —

Really appreciate the concise approach here. This is exactly the type of structured handoff our delivery leads have been asking for. High level: we’re in, and we’d like to pilot with two engineers from our integrations team.

Quick answers to your asks:
1) Nominations: I propose Jenna Ortiz (j.ortiz@clearpath.com) and Marcus Hale (m.hale@clearpath.com) — both have done pre-sales work but limited production Redwood experience.
2) Start window: week of Oct 8 would work best for us (gives time for scheduling + SOW).
3) SOW: yes — please draft a one-page SOW that calls out scope (mentorship hours, lab sessions, deliverables), pricing for a small pilot, and basic terms.

We also prefer to co-host the first two live shadow sessions; Simon and I can take the facilitation. I attached a draft SOW we sometimes use as a starting point (clearpath-sow-draft.docx).

If you want to lock this down, what do you need from me this week?

Thanks,
Simon
Simon Grant | Head of Integrations
ClearPath Consulting
simon@clearpath.com | +1 617-555-0242

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Grant <simon@clearpath.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 14:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: SI Mentorship & Shadowing Pilot with ClearPath Consulting

Simon —

Great to hear — welcome aboard. I’ll own the pilot operations and sync with Finance for a minimal commercial attachment. Next concrete steps from Redwood:
- Marissa will produce a mutual action plan (MAP) and a one-page pilot SOW for your review (expected by Tue, Sep 5).
- Camila will build the 3 lab exercises and a sandbox AMI; she’ll need the two engineer names (we have them) and a list of required roles/permissions.
- Vivek will serve as the mentor for this pilot (1:2). He’ll assign a weekly 1:1 cadence and two scheduled shadow sessions.

Proposed provisional schedule (to align with your Oct 8 start):
- Sep 5: MAP + Pilot SOW sent to ClearPath (Marissa)
- Sep 12: Kickoff call + environment provisioning checklist (all)
- Oct 8: Week 1 lab session + mentor pairing begins

Simon — can you confirm Jenna and Marcus’ availability windows for Sep 12–Oct 12? Also flag any required NDAs or compliance requirements we should be aware of.

I’ll create a shared Drive folder and drop the initial lab skeleton there. Drive link will be included in the MAP.

Laura Bennett | Head, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Grant <simon@clearpath.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 2 Sep 2028 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Proposal: SI Mentorship & Shadowing Pilot with ClearPath Consulting

Simon —

Happy to lead this. A few quick logistics from the mentor side so we don’t hit friction during week 1:
- Sandbox: Camila, I’ll need the AMI id and a short checklist for credentialing (I’ll attach the team access list once provided).
- Shadow sessions: I recommend two ~90-minute shadow sessions (customer scenario + runbook walkthrough) and one 3-hour hands-on lab where the ClearPath engineers deploy a small sample app and validate the inference pipeline.
- Evaluation: we’ll use a 6‑point readiness checklist (deployment completed, sizing rationale, monitoring configured, basic failover test, prompt set validation, post-deploy smoke test).

I uploaded the sample lab and an example readiness checklist to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSI-Mentorship-Resources

If Jenna and Marcus can share their calendars for Sep 12–Sep 20 windows that would speed provisioning. Otherwise, Marissa, I’m good to be booked for weekly 30-minute mentor sessions starting Oct 8.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Senior Technical Mentor, Integrations
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
